english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for restricting or slowing progress, development, or ideas.

exampleSentences.english: The company's layers of approval stultify our efforts to launch the new project.
exampleSentences.traditional: 公司層層審批，阻礙咗我哋推行新計劃。
